titleEn: Bathroom Renovation Port Moody 2026: Real Costs, Neighborhoods & Trusted Contractors
titleZh: 滿地寶浴室翻新2026：真實費用、社區指南及信譽承包商
contentEn:
A bathroom renovation in Port Moody in 2026 costs $12,000 to $50,000 depending on scope. A standard refresh runs $12,000–$25,000, a full gut renovation $25,000–$50,000, and a luxury master bath upgrade $50,000+. Port Moody's hilly terrain, older Heritage Mountain homes built in the 1980s–1990s, newer Newport Village condos, and proximity to Metro Vancouver all influence what your project will cost and how long it will take.

What Does a Bathroom Renovation Cost in Port Moody in 2026?

Based on Reno Stars' project data across the Tri-Cities and Port Moody area, here are the realistic 2026 cost ranges:

  • Standard Refresh ($12,000–$25,000): New vanity, faucet, toilet, flooring, paint, and re-caulking. Keeps existing plumbing rough-ins. Typical timeline: 3–5 weeks.
  • Full Gut Renovation ($25,000–$50,000): Complete demolition to studs, new tile (floor and shower/tub area), curbless shower or freestanding tub, plumbing rough-in, new vanity, quartz countertop, premium fixtures, LED lighting, and heated flooring. Typical timeline: 5–9 weeks.
  • Luxury Master Bath Upgrade ($50,000+): High-end materials including natural stone tile, custom millwork, designer fixtures, body-jet systems, steam shower, and smart toilet. Typical timeline: 9–16 weeks.

Port Moody sits within the City of Coquitlam's planning jurisdiction for most residential developments, meaning renovation permits follow Coquitlam municipal guidelines. Heritage Mountain homes may have additional architectural guidelines depending on the strata.

Port Moody Neighborhoods: Which Area Is Your Renovation In?

Port Moody's geography means renovation considerations vary significantly by neighbourhood:

  • Heritage Mountain: Single-family homes built primarily in the 1980s–1990s. These properties frequently have original bathroom finishes from the 1990s, making full-gut renovations common. Many homeowners here are renovating 30-year-old bathrooms for the first time. Structural considerations are minimal but older electrical panels may need upgrading.
  • Newport Village: Condominium developments from the 2000s onward. Condo bathroom renovations in Newport Village follow Port Moody strata bylaws, which are governed by the Strata Property Act. Cosmetic and mid-range renovations typically do not require strata council approval; work that moves plumbing fixtures does.
  • Ioco (Murray Street area): A mix of older character homes and newer infill developments near Port Moody's historic town core. Renovation projects here may be subject to Port Moody's heritage consideration guidelines for character homes.
  • North Shore (Barnet Highway corridor): Townhouse and duplex properties alongside newer condominium developments. Townhouse renovations frequently require strata approval regardless of scope — always check your strata bylaws before starting design.

Planning a renovation in Port Moody or the surrounding Tri-Cities area? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars, serving Port Moody, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, and the entire Metro Vancouver region.

How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take in Port Moody?

Timeline varies by project type and complexity. From Reno Stars' Port Moody and Tri-Cities project experience:

  • Standard refresh: 3–5 weeks
  • Full gut renovation: 5–9 weeks
  • Luxury master bath: 9–16 weeks

Permit timelines from the City of Coquitlam (which issues permits for Port Moody residential renovations) run 2–4 weeks for standard bathroom alterations. Asbestos assessments are required for any demolition work in buildings built before 1990 under WorkSafeBC regulations, which affects Heritage Mountain properties most frequently.

Bathroom Renovation Port Moody FAQ

How much does a full bathroom renovation cost in Port Moody in 2026?

A full bathroom renovation in Port Moody in 2026 costs $25,000 to $50,000 for a complete gut renovation including new tile, curbless shower, vanity, quartz countertop, and plumbing updates. A standard cosmetic refresh costs $12,000–$25,000, and a luxury master bathroom upgrade runs $50,000 and above. Heritage Mountain homeowners typically face higher renovation costs due to the age of existing mechanical systems.

Does Port Moody require a renovation permit for bathroom work?

The City of Coquitlam issues renovation permits for Port Moody residential properties. Cosmetic work such as flooring replacement, painting, and changing fixtures does not require a permit. Moving plumbing fixtures, altering electrical systems, or any work that affects structural elements requires a permit from Coquitlam's building department. Permit application timelines are typically 2–4 weeks. Condo renovations in Newport Village additionally require strata approval for any work that affects common property or building infrastructure.

What is the Strata Property Act and how does it affect my Port Moody condo renovation?

British Columbia's Strata Property Act governs all strata-titled properties, including condominiums in Port Moody's Newport Village and North Shore areas. The Act requires strata council approval for any renovation work that alters common property, affects the building's structure, or changes plumbing and electrical systems beyond the unit's boundaries. Cosmetic work within your own unit — painting, changing flooring, updating fixtures — generally does not require strata approval. Reno Stars manages all strata application paperwork as part of its full-scope bathroom renovation service.

Which areas of Metro Vancouver does Reno Stars serve from its Port Moody base?

Reno Stars operates out of the Tri-Cities area and serves all of Metro Vancouver, including Port Moody, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Burnaby, New Westminster, North Vancouver, and Vancouver. A representative bathroom renovation project from the nearby Tri-Cities area — a full bathroom renovation with curbless shower, floating vanity, and heated flooring — was completed for $31,000. See the project at Coquitlam standard bathroom renovation for details.

2026年，滿地寶（Port Moody）浴室翻新費用根據工程範圍從12,000至50,000加元以上不等。基本翻新12,000至25,000，全面拆修25,000至50,000，豪華主浴升級50,000以上。滿地寶丘陵地形、1980至1990年代建的Heritage Mountain老宅、全新的Newport Village公寓，以及毗鄰大溫哥華的地理位置，都會影響您工程的造價和工期。

2026年滿地寶浴室翻新多少錢？

根據聚星裝修在滿地寶及三聯市地區的項目數據，2026年的現實費用區間如下：

  • 基本翻新（12,000–25,000加元）：新洗臉盆、水龍頭、馬桶、地板刷新、牆面油漆及重新填縫。保留現有管道預埋。典型工期：3至5週。
  • 全面拆修（25,000–50,000加元）：完全拆除至結構層，新瓷磚（地板及淋浴/浴缸區）、無障礙淋浴間或獨立浴缸、管道預埋更新、新洗臉盆、石英石檯面、優質五金、LED照明及地暖。典型工期：5至9週。
  • 豪華主浴升級（50,000加元以上）：高端材料包括天然石材瓷磚、定製細木加工、設計師五金、按摩噴頭系統、蒸汽淋浴及智能馬桶。典型工期：9至16週。

滿地寶隸屬於高貴林市的規劃管轄範圍，大多數住宅翻新許可證遵循高貴林市指南。Heritage Mountain社區的住宅可能另有建築設計指南，視具體strata管委會而定。

滿地寶社區：您的翻新工程在哪個區域？

滿地寶的地形特點意味著各社區的翻新考量差異很大：

  • Heritage Mountain：主要建於1980至1990年代的獨立屋。這些住宅的浴室裝修通常是1990年代的原始標準，全面拆修情況常見。許多業主是首次翻新使用了30年的浴室。結構問題不多，但較老的配電箱可能需要升級。
  • Newport Village：2000年代起的公寓住宅小區。Newport Village的公寓浴室翻新遵循滿地寶strata管委會章程，由《BC省共管財產法》（Strata Property Act）管轄。美容及中等翻新通常無需strata管委會批准；移動衛生管道設備的工程則需要。
  • Ioco（Murray Street區）：靠近滿地寶歷史城核心的混合新舊住宅開發項目。此區域的翻新工程可能需要遵守滿地寶對特色住宅的Heritage考量指南。
  • 北岸（Barnet Highway走廊）：城市屋及聯排別墅，與更新的公寓開發項目相伴。城市屋翻新，不論工程範圍，通常需要strata批准——開工前務必查閱您所在strata的章程。

滿地寶浴室翻新需要多長時間？

工期因項目類型和複雜程度而異。根據聚星裝修在滿地寶及三聯市的項目經驗：

  • 基本翻新：3至5週
  • 全面拆修：5至9週
  • 豪華主浴室：9至16週

高貴林市政府（為滿地寶住宅翻新頒發許可證）對標準浴室改建工程的許可證審批時間通常為2至4週。1990年以前建成的建築物在拆除前需要根據WorkSafeBC規定進行石棉評估，這對Heritage Mountain房產影響最大。

滿地寶浴室翻新常見問題

2026年滿地寶全面浴室翻新多少錢？

2026年，滿地寶全面浴室翻新（包括新瓷磚、無障礙淋浴間、洗臉盆、石英石檯面及管道更新）造價25,000至50,000加元。基本美容翻新造價12,000至25,000加元，豪華主浴室升級造價50,000加元以上。Heritage Mountain的業主由於現有機械系統年齡的問題，通常面臨較高的翻新費用。

滿地寶浴室工程需要許可證嗎？

為滿地寶住宅房產頒發裝修許可證的是高貴林市政府。美容工程如更換地板、油漆及更換五金無需許可證。移動衛生管道設備、改動電氣系統或任何影響結構構件的工程需要向高貴林市建築部門申請許可證。許可證申請時間通常為2至4週。Newport Village及北岸公寓的翻新工程還需要strata管委會批准任何影響公共財產或建築基礎設施的工程。

《共管財產法》（Strata Property Act）如何影響我在滿地寶的公寓翻新？

BC省《共管財產法》管轄所有strata產權公寓，包括滿地寶Newport Village和北岸區域的公寓。該法要求strata管委會批准任何改動公共財產、影響建築結構或改動管道和電氣系統（超出單位範圍）的翻新工程。單位內部的美容工程——油漆、更換地板、更新五金——通常無需strata批准。聚星裝修作為全面浴室翻新服務的一部分，代為處理所有strata申請文件。

聚星裝修從滿地寶基地服務大溫哥華哪些區域？

聚星裝修總部位於三聯市地區，服務整個大溫哥華，包括滿地寶、高貴林、高貴林港、本拿比、新西敏、北溫哥華及溫哥華。三聯市附近地區一個具代表性的浴室翻新項目——包括無障礙淋浴間、懸掛式洗臉盆和地暖的全面浴室翻新——造價31,000加元。查看高貴林標準浴室翻新項目了解詳情。
